entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this piece of junk VeloBand Pulse you sold me. I've had it for a few weeks and it's absolutely useless. I want my money back. Now.

I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your VeloBand Pulse. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

Don't try to troubleshoot me! It doesn't matter what the issue is. It doesn't work as advertised and I want to return it. Your website says I have 90 days, so just process the return. My order number is VF-8675309.
I understand your frustration, sir. Thank you for the order number. Let me just pull up your account and review the return eligibility. One moment.
There's nothing to review! I'm looking at your return policy right now. It says 90 days! Are you going to process this or do I need to speak to your manager and file a complaint?

No, that won't be necessary. You are absolutely correct, my apologies for the delay. I'm looking at your purchase details now. I see the item was delivered on December 15th, which was 19 days ago. You are well within the 90-day return window.
See! I told you. Was that so hard? Finally. Okay, so what's next? Send me the label.

Of course. I've just processed the return authorization for you. I'm sending the email with the pre-paid shipping label to the address we have on file. Simply print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives the item, we will issue a full refund to your original payment method.
Good. That's all I wanted. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
